subject.title: Fix MiMo Firefox session cookie import

question: Must this PR demonstrate a real authenticated MiMo recovery from Firefox sessionstore before merge, or is the current test suite plus unauthenticated real-profile parse sufficient?
rationale: Automation cannot create or inspect an authorized MiMo account session, while the patch changes which local credential state is accepted as authoritative.

options.title: Require authenticated proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted runtime evidence shows this exact head recovering Firefox session cookies and completing an authenticated MiMo fetch.

options.title: Accept current evidence
options.body: Explicitly accept the clean tests, bounded real-file parsing, and reviewed precedence rules without an authenticated live result.

recommendation.title: Require authenticated proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted runtime evidence shows this exact head recovering Firefox session cookies and completing an authenticated MiMo fetch.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the branch's principal hardening commits and recorded the intended cookie-source policy in review discussion.
